title: On State Reduction in Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2602.04852v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear attention offers a computationally efficient yet expressive alternative to softmax attention. However, recent empirical results indicate that the hidden state of trained linear attention models often exhibits a low-rank structure, suggesting that these models underexploit their capacity in practice. To understand this phenomenon, we analyze how keys and values shape the rank of the recurrent state, providing a theoretical perspective on memory utilization in linear attention. In addition to these theoretical insights, we conjecture that low-rank states can be substantially reduced after pre-training. To this end, we propose a hardware-aware strategy to structurally prune the key and query matrices, reducing the state size while retaining compatibility with existing fast kernels. translated_title: 论线性注意力中的状态缩减
translated_abstract: 线性注意力为softmax注意力提供了一种计算高效且具表达力的替代方案。然而，近期的实证结果表明，经过训练的线性注意力模型的隐藏状态往往呈现低秩结构，这表明这些模型在实践中未能充分利用其容量。为了理解这一现象，我们分析了键和值如何塑造循环状态的秩，为线性注意力中的内存利用率提供了理论视角。除了这些理论洞见之外，我们推测低秩状态可以在预训练之后被大幅缩减。为此，我们提出了一种硬件感知的策略来对键矩阵和查询矩阵进行结构化剪枝，在减小状态规模的同时保持与现有快速内核的兼容性。我们调整了若干现有的剪枝策略以适配我们的框架，并在理论分析的基础上提出了一种鲁棒的结构化剪枝方法。
tldr: 该论文从理论上分析了键和值如何决定线性注意力循环状态的秩，并提出一种硬件感知的结构化剪枝方法，可在预训练后大幅缩减键和查询矩阵规模，同时保持与现有快速内核的兼容性。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of how keys and values determine the rank of the recurrent state in linear attention, and proposes a hardware-aware structured pruning method that substantially reduces the key and query matrices after pre-training while remaining compatible with existing fast kernels.
